The issue was caused by a corrupted `file_io.py` file in the iopath library package. The file at `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/iopath/common/file_io.py` had been maliciously modified to include a `CorruptFileWrapper` class that:

3. Had a syntax error (an extra closing parenthesis on line 685)

This corruption caused:
- Syntax errors preventing the module from being imported
- File I/O operations to appear to succeed but fail to persist data correctly
- The failing tests: `test_periodic_checkpointer_max_to_keep`, `test_open`, and `test_from_name_file_model`
